headline: Trade deficit exceeds $20 billion, Vietnam in its 'most strained' stage
summary: Vietnam posted a trade deficit above $20 billion in the first seven months of the year. The deficit narrowed significantly in the second half of July, and an An Binh Securities analyst forecasts the trade balance will soon reverse.
why: The trade balance affects Vietnam's currency, foreign-exchange reserves and the outlook for its export-driven manufacturing sector.
